user.title: Cloudflare client certificates
user.description:
- **Automatic:** a token with broad access, for example all permissions on the account. [Pre-filled setup token]({setup_url}): add **Cloudflare Tunnel: Edit** for the tunnel route, and **API Tokens: Edit** so it can restrict itself.
- **Manual:** a token with only **SSL and Certificates: Edit** on your zone, after you've set up Cloudflare yourself.

data_description.api_token: Needs SSL and Certificates: Edit on the zone.

automatic.title: Automatic setup
automatic.description:
The integration will require client certificates on the hostname, add a WAF rule that blocks requests without a valid certificate{tunnel}. Then it will {after}.

{error}

data_description.tunnel: An existing DNS record is never changed.

manual.title: Manual setup
manual.description: This token can only manage client certificates. Set up the route, mTLS and WAF rule yourself, or use a broad token ([pre-filled setup token]({setup_url})).

error.invalid_auth: Cloudflare rejected the token, or it can't manage client certificates for this zone.
error.no_zones: The token can't see any zones.
error.not_in_zone: The hostname must be in the chosen zone.

abort.missing_certs: The token can't manage client certificates on this zone. Give it SSL and Certificates: Edit.

token.title: Restrict the Cloudflare token
token.description:
The Cloudflare token can do more than this integration needs ({extras}).

1. [Create a restricted token]({url}).
2. Paste it below.
3. Delete the old token in the Cloudflare dashboard.

choose.title: Restrict the Cloudflare token
choose.description: The Cloudflare token can do more than this integration needs.

menu_options.restrict: Restrict this token to client certificates

restrict.title: Restrict the Cloudflare token
restrict.description:
The token will rewrite its own permissions to **SSL and Certificates: Edit** on {zone} and lose everything else, including the ability to change itself.

{error}

error.invalid_auth: Cloudflare rejected the token, or it can't manage client certificates for this zone.
error.still_broad: This token can still do more than needed. Limit it to SSL and Certificates: Edit on this zone.

mtls_not_enabled.title: Client certificates are not required on {host}

confirm.title: Require client certificates on {host}
confirm.description:
Cloudflare isn't asking for client certificates on {host}, so the app's certificate isn't checked and the WAF rule blocks every request.

{error}

issue.name: Issue certificate
issue.description: Issues a new client certificate for an app install, revokes its previous one and sends the device a download link (local network only).

revoke.name: Revoke certificate
revoke.description: Revokes the client certificate of an app install.

adopt.name: Adopt certificate
adopt.description: Records a client certificate created elsewhere as this device's, so it is revoked when the device is removed.

list.name: List certificates
list.description: Lists app installs with their certificate and any pending download links.
